name: slot-machine-roll
description: A vertical reel scrolls characters from one value to another.

vars.description: Characters the reels land on, one reel column per character. Whitespace is stripped and every reel starts on a zero.
Which way the reels roll: up lifts the zero out through the top, down drops it out through the bottom.
Reel height and type size. The roll distance scales with it so the reel always lands exactly one row on.
Character colour: ink for light frames, paper for dark ones, accent rides --brand.
